description: Source file implementing default batched buffer operations for the IGraphicBufferProducer interface in Android, with methods for requesting, dequeuing, attaching, queueing, canceling buffers, and querying buffer states.

classes.name: IGraphicBufferProducer
classes.description: Interface class providing default implementations for batched buffer operations related to graphic buffer production.

methods.name: requestBuffers
methods.description: Requests buffers for specified slots and outputs the results.

methods.name: dequeueBuffers
methods.description: Dequeues buffers based on input parameters, providing buffer details and synchronization fences.

methods.name: attachBuffers
methods.description: Attaches graphic buffers to specified slots.

methods.name: queueBuffers
methods.description: Queues buffers for display or processing.

methods.name: cancelBuffers
methods.description: Cancels buffer operations for specified slots.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Queries the status or properties of buffers.
